info.title: PayerPrice API Documentation
info.description:
PayerPrice's healthcare price transparency APIs give you access to negotiated rates, provider information, and market benchmarks across the United States. Use them to power reimbursement analytics, build provider directories, and retrieve fee schedules.

## Quickstart

1. Copy your API key from the account bar at the top of the API Doc page. If no key is assigned, email [support@payerprice.com](mailto:support@payerprice.com).
2. Send the key as a Bearer token over HTTPS. Make a first request to list available payers and data periods:

```bash
curl https://api.payerprice.com/api/v1/payers \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'
```

3. The response is an array of objects with a `payer` name and `yearMonths` entries. Use a returned payer and period when building a pricing request. [See the payer endpoint](/api/doc#tag/payer-apis/GET/api/v1/payers).
4. Next, [get market benchmarks](/api/doc#tag/pricing-apis/POST/api/v1/market/benchmarks) for a comparable market or [get provider rates](/api/doc#tag/pricing-apis/POST/api/v1/provider/rates) for a specific NPI, TIN, or CCN.

Keep your API key private. Never commit it to source control or share it publicly.

## Credits and pricing

- Requests made with an API key spend your organization's API/MCP credit, the same balance MCP tool calls use. Trial accounts start with API/MCP trial credit, counted in calls. Signed-in members of paid organizations see each endpoint's price at the top of its description.
- **Test Request** sends a real request and uses credit. Nothing is sent until you click that button.
- A request without enough credit returns `402`. Check your balance and add credits from the account bar, and track spending in the [usage dashboard](https://app.payerprice.com/app/profile?tab=api-usage).

## Integration essentials

- A missing or invalid key returns `401`; a forbidden request returns `403`. Invalid filters can return `400`.
- Rate limiting returns `429`; back off before retrying. Retry reads after transient failures, but do not blindly repeat create, update, or delete requests.
- Pagination and asynchronous processing vary by endpoint. Follow each operation's request and response fields. Report creation can finish after the initial request; use its documented status and data-retrieval workflow.
- API paths use `/api/v1`. The OpenAPI version describes this contract; payer `yearMonths` describe available source-data periods. These are separate versions.

## Resources

- [Download the OpenAPI specification](/api/doc/openapi.json) using a signed-in browser session or an `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` header. Credentials are never embedded in the response.
- [Read Markdown docs](/api/doc.md) or [the API index for agents](/llms.txt).
- [Read the MCP documentation](/mcp/doc) to connect AI assistants and agents to PayerPrice data.

APIKeyAuth.name: Authorization
APIKeyAuth.description: Pass your API key in the `Authorization` header as a Bearer token. Example: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.

Error.description: Body of every error response. Validation failures also list the offending fields in `errors`.

message.description: What went wrong, in plain language.

errors.description: Validation issues, present on some 400 responses.

ReportDataFilterGroup.description: A recursive filter group. `op` combines every entry in `filters` with AND or OR. Each entry is either a comparison filter or another group, so groups can be nested. An empty `filters` array applies no filter.

op.description: Logical operator joining this group's filters.

filters.description: Comparison filters or nested filter groups.

ReportDataSingleFilter.description: One comparison against a report column. Supply `value` for comparisons; omit it for `IS_NULL` and `IS_NOT_NULL`. Filter fields need not appear in `getRawData.columnAggregations` but must be available on the report.

op.description: Comparison operator. `EQUAL`/`NOT_EQUAL` test equality, `GREATER_THAN`/`LESS_THAN` and their `_OR_EQUAL` variants compare ordered values, `IS_NULL`/`IS_NOT_NULL` test nulls, and `CONTAINS`/`NOT_CONTAINS`/`MATCH_WORDS` perform text matching.

field.description: Report column name to filter, such as `payer` or `service_codes`.

value.description: Comparison value. Use a string, number, or boolean matching the column's value type. Omit for null checks; arrays and null are not accepted.
TIN value normalized from 8- to 10-digit pasted input. Formatting characters and leading zeroes are removed.

title.description: Optional display label. When omitted, the API uses the numeric TIN as the title.

grouping.description: Optional display grouping. When omitted, the API stores null.

ContractModelRateAggregation.description: Allowlisted aggregation used to combine negotiated rates within a Contract Model rate column.

id.description: Stable lowercase alphanumeric column ID used by `baselineBenchmark` and manual-rate keys.

tins.description: Unique TINs whose rates are combined into this competitor column.

SavedContractModelConfig.description: Saved state for the Contract Modeling report tab. Every property is optional; omitted values use the client defaults. The serialized configuration is limited to 250,000 characters.

dropdownFilters.description: Saved dropdown filter tree using the standard report FilterGroup operators.

baselineBenchmark.description: Target scenario used to calculate the modeled opportunity. Use `p50`, `p75`, or `p90` for the 50th-, 75th-, or 90th-percentile market rate. To target a selected competitor column, use `competitor_<columnId>`, where `<columnId>` is the `id` of an entry in `competitorColumns`; for example, `competitor_example1`. The client falls back to `p75` when the saved value is missing or no longer matches an available target.

baselineColumn.description: Column treated as Your Rate when comparing against `baselineBenchmark`. Use `negotiated_rate` (the public/default value) to calculate Your Rate from `yourTins`. A saved dynamic dollar-rate column's exact `accessorKey` can also be used when that column exists in the same saved configuration; dynamic-column configuration is not part of the currently documented public schema. If the requested column is unavailable, the client prefers `negotiated_rate`, then the first eligible rate column.

manualRates.description: Manual rate overrides keyed by the serialized Contract Model column and row identity.

event.description: Archive hides a report from active lists; Unarchive restores it.
Soft-deletes the report so it no longer appears in report lists.

operationIndex.description: Zero-based index of the invalid operation when the request shape was parseable.

resolvedEntities.description: Complete schema-v2 resolved contract entities after this edit batch.

entityId.description: Stable entity ID from the resolved document, or `root` for a root field or collection.

fieldPath.description: Allowlisted field or collection path selected by the operation variant.

value.description: Required for set and append_entity. Append values must be a canonical named-party, named-scope, location, contract-clause, or non-pricing payment-policy entity.

entityId.description: Stable ID of an existing non-pricing entity; `root` is invalid.

value.description: Canonical entity object for the selected collection, including a stable unique `id`. Pricing policies and reimbursement clauses are rejected.

clauseType.description: Reimbursement-rule and lesser-of clause types are rejected in v1.

effect.description: Effects containing pricing are rejected in v1.

FacilityType.description: Broad facility category. Every facility has one. `ASC` is an ambulatory surgery center; `HEALTH_CENTER` is an FQHC or other HRSA-funded health center.

CcnFacilityType.description: CMS hospital category derived from the CCN's number range. Facilities other than hospitals usually have none; filter them with `facilityTypes`. `null` matches facilities without a category.

enum: Psychiatric Unit in Critical Access Hospital
Rehabilitation Unit in Critical Access Hospital
Swing-Bed Hospital Designation for Short-Term Hospitals
Swing-Bed Hospital Designation for Long Term Care Hospitals
Swing-Bed Hospital Designation for Rehabilitation Hospitals
CcnCategory.description: CMS unit or swing-bed designation encoded in the CCN. Most facilities have none; `null` matches them.

MedicareClaimInfoRow.description: Medicare fee-for-service services and payments for one HCPCS code, place of service, and year.

MedicaidClaimInfoRow.description: Medicaid claims, beneficiaries, and payments for one HCPCS code and year.

ClinicianQuality.description: CMS Doctors and Clinicians quality data for one NPI: MIPS scores, procedure volume, Medicare services, and affiliated facilities.

NpiRegistry.description: One NPI's CMS NPPES registry record, holding what the other `/npis` fields do not: the legal name, structured addresses, taxonomy licenses, and registry dates. Dates are as NPPES publishes them; null fields are not reported.

CcnQuality.description: CMS quality results for one care setting: the overall star rating and headline measures `POST /api/v1/ccnSearch` also returns, plus every measure CMS reports for the facility with state averages, national ranks, and value-based program history.

overallStarRating.description: CMS overall star rating from 1 to 5, when CMS publishes one for the setting.

latestSourceRelease.description: Release of the newest CMS dataset behind these measures.

score.description: Score as CMS publishes it, which can be text.

value.description: Numeric score, when the score is a number.

compared.description: CMS comparison with the national result, when published.

denominator.description: Cases or patients behind the score.

source.description: CMS dataset the measure comes from.

national.description: How this value ranks among every US facility CMS reports for the measure. The median is per facility, not weighted by patients.

allMeasures.description: Every measure CMS reports for the setting. Empty when CMS publishes only the headline measures.

allMeasuresSourceRelease.description: CMS release of `allMeasures`, which can differ from the headline measures' release.

summary.description: Headline figures from the CMS Hospital Provider Cost Report. Null when CMS has no record.

detail.description: The HCRIS cost report (Form 2552-10) in detail: income statement, balance sheet, community benefit, utilization, units, departments, and prior years. Null when CMS has no record.

CcnFinancials.description: The facility's latest Medicare cost report from two CMS sources, which can cover different reporting periods. Null when CMS has neither.

HospitalCmsProfile.description: CMS Provider of Services and enrollment facts: accreditation, ownership and changes of ownership, staffing, facilities, service area, and nonprofit filings. Null when CMS has no record.

HospitalMedicareServices.description: Medicare inpatient DRGs and outpatient APCs CMS publishes for the facility, most volume first, with the hospital's CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) Impact File figures. A hospital missing from the full DRG table lists only its most common DRGs, with discharges and average total payment. Null when CMS has no record.

HospitalClinicians.description: Clinicians CMS lists as affiliated with the facility: the count, top specialties, and up to 24 clinicians, ordered by Medicare services billed in all settings. Null when CMS has no record.

FacilityQuality.description: CMS quality results for one care setting.

overallStarRating.description: CMS overall star rating from 1 to 5, when CMS publishes one for the setting.

latestSourceRelease.description: Release of the newest CMS dataset behind these measures.

score.description: Score as CMS publishes it, which can be text.

value.description: Numeric score, when the score is a number.

compared.description: CMS comparison with the national result, when published.

denominator.description: Cases or patients behind the score.

source.description: CMS dataset the measure comes from.

national.description: How this value ranks among every US facility CMS reports for the measure. The median is per facility, not weighted by patients.

TaxonomyCode.description: NUCC healthcare provider taxonomy code (10-character alphanumeric, e.g., `208000000X` for Pediatrics).

BillingCodeType.description: Billing code system. `CPT` = Current Procedural Terminology, `HCPCS` = Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System, `RC` = Revenue Code, `MS-DRG` / `APR-DRG` / `AP-DRG` / `DRG` = Diagnosis Related Group, `NDC` = National Drug Code, `CDT` = dental procedure code, `APC` / `EAPG` = outpatient payment group, `HIPPS` = Health Insurance Prospective Payment System code, `ICD` / `ICD_DIAG` / `ICD_PROC` = ICD-10 diagnosis or procedure code, `LOCAL` = payer-specific code, `CSTM-ALL` = custom/all codes. Every type `POST /api/v1/billingCode/search` returns is accepted here; most negotiated rates are published under `CPT`, `HCPCS`, `RC`, and the DRG types, so other types often return no rows.

description.description: Item or service description as published.

payer.description: Payer the charge is for, as normalized (e.g. `Aetna`, `Aetna Medicare`).

plan.description: Hospital-reported plan names, deduplicated and sorted.

negotiatedPercentage.description: Payer-specific negotiated charge as a percentage (of charges, not dollars).

estimatedAmount.description: Hospital-reported estimated allowed amount for a percentage or algorithm rate.

methodology.description: Methodology as published (e.g. `FEE SCHEDULE`, `CASE RATE`, `PER DIEM`).

PriceFileBenchmark.description: One benchmark group: its `groupBy` values and each requested statistic, under their request names.

ServiceCode.description: CMS place of service code as a two-character string (e.g., `11` for office, `21` for inpatient hospital, `22` for outpatient hospital).

BillingCodeModifier.description: CPT/HCPCS modifier. `TC` = technical component, `26` = professional component, `none` = no modifier.

YearMonth.description: Year and month specifier for a time period.

NegotiatedTypeGroup.description: How a rate is expressed, grouped as Report Data's negotiated_type_group does. `dollar` = negotiated, fee schedule, and every other dollar type. `derived` = derived from another rate arrangement. `per diem` = daily rate. `percentage` = a percentage of a base amount, not dollars.

NegotiatedType.description: Raw rate type; prefer NegotiatedTypeGroup unless negotiated and fee schedule rates must be shown apart. How the rate was negotiated. `negotiated` = directly negotiated between payer and provider. `derived` = derived from another rate arrangement. `fee schedule` = from a published fee schedule. `percentage` = expressed as a percentage of a base amount. `per diem` = daily rate for inpatient services.

GroupByField.description: Field to group results by. 'network' splits results per individual (un-normalized) network name; a rate in multiple networks contributes to each. 'negotiatedTypeGroup' groups rate types as dollar (negotiated and fee schedule together), derived, per diem, or percentage, matching Report Data's negotiated_type_group; prefer it to 'negotiatedType', which splits negotiated from fee schedule rates.

ProviderGroupByField.description: Field to group provider-rate results by. 'network' and 'planName' return deduplicated arrays without splitting otherwise-identical rate rows. 'planName' arrays are sorted and limited to at most 30 names. 'negotiatedTypeGroup' groups rate types as dollar (negotiated and fee schedule together), derived, per diem, or percentage, matching Report Data's negotiated_type_group; prefer it to 'negotiatedType', which splits negotiated from fee schedule rates.

post.description: Retrieve provider information for one or more National Provider Identifiers (NPIs).

npiDirectoryDetails.summary: Example 2: Get an organization's CCNs, addresses, related NPIs, and most billed codes
npiDirectoryDetails.description: Query directory details for an organization NPI

npiProfileDetails.summary: Example 3: Get a provider's claim volume, CMS quality, and NPPES registry record
npiProfileDetails.description: Query claim, quality, and registry details for one NPI

npis.description: Array of NPI numbers to query

includeFields.description:
List of fields to include in the response. `ccns`, `taxonomies`, `relatedNpis`, `practiceAddress`, `mailingAddress`, `otherNames`, and `topCodes` are the values `POST /api/v1/npiSearch` returns, and are absent for an NPI the provider directory has not indexed.
- `taxonomies`: all of the provider's taxonomy codes; `primaryTaxonomyCode` is the primary one.
- `ccns`: CMS Certification Numbers linked to the NPI.
- `topCodes`: up to 20 codes the provider bills most, as `{code, type}` entries (for example `{"code": "99213", "type": "CPT"}`), ranked by Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial claim volume, or the specialty's most billed codes when the provider has no claims. Requires a signed-in user or API key.
- `medicareClaimInfo`: Medicare fee-for-service services and payments by HCPCS code, place of service, and year. Requires a signed-in user or API key.
- `medicaidClaimInfo`: Medicaid claims, beneficiaries, and payments by HCPCS code and year. Requires a signed-in user or API key.
- `quality`: CMS Doctors and Clinicians quality data: MIPS final score and categories, procedure volume, Medicare services, and affiliated facilities. Absent when CMS publishes none for the NPI.
- `registry`: the NPI's CMS NPPES registry record: legal name, authorized official, mailing and practice addresses, taxonomies with licenses, other names and identifiers, health information exchange endpoints, and enumeration, update, and deactivation dates. At most 10 NPIs per request. Requires a signed-in user or API key.

Each field is returned only when requested.

type.description: Billing code type, such as `CPT`, `HCPCS`, or `RC`

facilityQuality.description: CMS ratings of the facility registered under an organization NPI, one per care setting; requested with `quality`. A setting is omitted when the NPI has more than one facility in it.

401.description: A claim field, `topCodes`, or `registry` was requested without a signed-in user or API key

402.description: Not enough API credit for this request.

429.description: Request rate limit exceeded; retry after backing off.

post.description: Fuzzy search for NPIs by name or NPI. Optionally filter results by taxonomy, state, county, or entity type.

npiSearch.summary: Example 1: Search for NPI by name

npiSearchOrganization.summary: Example 2: Find an organization NPI with its addresses, CCNs, and related NPIs
npiSearchOrganization.description: Search organization NPIs by name in one state

cmsCodes.description: CPT or HCPCS codes, for example `["95004", "95024"]`. Keeps providers with Medicare or Medicaid volume in any of them, and adds `cmsVolume` (all codes) and `cmsCodeVolumes` (each requested code's volume) to every result. Volume is Medicare services plus Medicaid claims over every loaded year. A provider's index entry holds its 100 highest-volume codes, so a code it bills rarely may not match, and CMS omits low-volume rows. Requires a signed-in user or API key (401 otherwise). Returns 503 while the search index does not yet hold CMS volume.

field.description: Order by CMS volume (Medicare services plus Medicaid claims, all loaded years): volume in `cmsCodes` when given, otherwise total volume. Medicare counts services, so each billing unit of a drug (a J code) or lab test counts as one and drug- or lab-heavy providers rank high on total volume. Providers without volume come last. Not allowed with `near`. Returns 503 while the search index does not yet hold CMS volume. Not available to trial accounts (403) or unauthenticated requests (401).

sort.description: Sort order as a list holding one `{field, direction}` entry. Only one sort entry is supported; a request with more than one returns 400.

searchTerm.description: Search term to match against provider names or NPIs.

matchFields.description: Fields used for text matching. Defaults to displayName, ccns, otherNames, and tins.

includeFields.description:
List of fields to include in the response. `npi`, `displayName`, and `state` are always returned.
- `taxonomies`: the provider's taxonomy codes.
- `ccns`: CMS Certification Numbers linked to the NPI.
- `practiceAddress`, `mailingAddress`: NPPES addresses.
- `topCodes`: up to 20 codes the provider bills most, as `{code, type}` entries (for example `{"code": "99213", "type": "CPT"}`), ranked by Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial claim volume, or the specialty's most billed codes when the provider has no claims. Requires a signed-in user or API key.

taxonomyCodes.description: List of taxonomy codes to filter by

states.description: List of two-letter state codes to filter by

counties.description: List of county names to filter by

inNetworkPayers.description: Restrict results to entries whose inNetworkPayers contains at least one of the given payers.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 100; a value above 3,000 returns 400.

tins.description: Tax IDs the NPI bills under, as numbers (a leading zero is not kept, so pad to nine digits to display an EIN). A ten-digit entry is an NPI billing under its own number. Requires a signed-in user or API key.

type.description: Billing code type, such as `CPT`, `HCPCS`, or `RC`

cmsVolume.description: Medicare services plus Medicaid claims over every loaded year, all codes. Returned for `cmsCodes` or `sort` field `cmsVolume` searches. Not patients, and not commercial volume.

cmsCodeVolumes.description: The same measure for each requested `cmsCodes` code this provider has, highest first. Returned with `cmsCodes`.

401.description: `sort` or `cmsCodes` without a signed-in user or API key

402.description: Not enough API credit for this request.

429.description: Request rate limit exceeded; retry after backing off.

503.description: `cmsCodes` or `sort` field `cmsVolume` while the search index does not yet hold CMS volume

post.description: Search for **market-level aggregate statistics** and benchmarks. Results summarize published rates in the selected payer, geography, taxonomy, billing-code, and period cohort; they are not prices for a specific provider or a guarantee of claim payment. Published rates of $0 (bundled or not paid separately) are left out of the statistics. Keep billing class, service code, modifier, and negotiated type comparable when interpreting percentiles. An empty result may reflect an overly narrow filter or missing published data.

marketBenchmarksExample.summary: Example: Market Benchmarks for Office Visits
marketBenchmarksExample.description: Get market statistics (50th, 75th, 90th, 95th percentiles) for pediatric office visits in Massachusetts

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return. A group is one combination of the `groupBy` values and always keeps all of its metric rows, so the response can hold more rows than `limit`. API-key requests default to 1,000 groups; a value above 10,000 returns 400. When a limit applies, groups without a `sort` are ordered by their group values so pages are stable, and the response headers `X-Total-Count` (matching groups) and `X-Has-More` (`true` or `false`) say whether more remain.

offset.description: Number of groups to skip before the page starts.

field.description: Order the groups by one of the requested `metrics.aggregations` (for example `percentile_50`). A group's rows stay together; groups with the same value are ordered by their group fields, and groups without the value come last. The groups are ordered after the query runs. Returns 400 when the value is not among the requested aggregations. Not available to trial accounts (403) or unauthenticated requests (401).

sort.description: Sort order as a list holding one `{field, direction}` entry. Only one sort entry is supported; a request with more than one returns 400.

states.description: Array of US state codes to filter by (required for market benchmarks).

zipCodes.description: 5-digit US ZIP codes to filter results by provider location (e.g., 02451, 90210).

state.description: Two-letter state code of the county. It must also be listed in states.

county.description: Census county name, e.g. Fairfax County, Fairfax city, or Orleans Parish. Case, accents, and Saint/St. are ignored; the suffix may be omitted when only one county in the state has that name.

counties.description: Counties providers must be located in, as state and county pairs (e.g., [{"state": "VA", "county": "Fairfax County"}]). Narrows states; each county's state must also be in states.

metroAreaMsaCodes.description: Metropolitan Statistical Areas providers must be located in, as five-digit metropolitan CBSA codes (e.g., 47900 for Washington-Arlington-Alexandria). Use the metro area code, not a metropolitan division code such as 47894. Narrows states, which must include at least one of the metro area's states.

taxonomyCodes.description: Array of provider taxonomy codes (required for market benchmarks).

billingCodeAndTypes.description: Specific billing codes to search for (required).

billingClasses.description: Professional vs institutional (optional). Rates a payer published for `both` classes are returned under either.

serviceCodes.description: Place of service codes (e.g., office, hospital, telehealth) to search for (optional) Rates published with no place of service or `CSTM-00` apply at every place of service and are always returned; group by `serviceCode` to tell them apart.

negotiatedTypeGroups.description: Rate type groups to search for (optional), e.g. ["dollar"]. Prefer this to negotiatedTypes. 'dollar' covers negotiated, fee schedule, and every other dollar type; 'per diem' and 'percentage' values are not dollars per service.

negotiatedTypes.description: Raw rate negotiation types to search for (optional); prefer negotiatedTypeGroups unless negotiated and fee schedule rates must be separated. When both are set, a rate must match both.

yearMonths.description: Year/month periods to filter by (optional). Leave empty to query the latest available data; supply specific periods only when comparing rates across time.

planNames.description: Normalized plan names to narrow results to specific insurance plans (optional).

networks.description: Individual (un-normalized) network names to narrow results to specific networks, exactly as reported in the payer transparency file (optional).

aggregations.description: Statistical metrics to calculate (required for market benchmarks)

comparedTo.description: Optional. `medicare_<year>` returns every rate statistic as a percent of the national non-facility Medicare Physician Fee Schedule amount for that year (145 means 145%). Omit or use `none` for dollar values.

groupBy.description: Fields to group results by (optional). Including network returns a separate benchmark group for each individual network name.

X-Total-Count.description: Number of groups matching the request, sent when a limit or offset applies.

X-Has-More.description: `true` when groups remain after this page, sent when a limit or offset applies.

value.description: The numeric value for the metric

taxonomyCode.description: Provider taxonomy code (included when groupBy contains 'taxonomyCode')

entityType.description: Provider entity type (included when groupBy contains 'entityType')

billingCodeType.description: Billing code type (included when groupBy contains 'billingCodeType')

negotiatedType.description: Raw negotiated rate type (included when groupBy contains 'negotiatedType'); prefer negotiatedTypeGroup unless negotiated and fee schedule rates must be shown apart

negotiatedTypeGroup.description: Negotiated rate type group (included when groupBy contains 'negotiatedTypeGroup')

billingCodeModifier.description: Billing code modifier (included when groupBy contains 'billingCodeModifier')

billingCodeGroup.description: Billing code group as `(<first code>-<last code>) <label>` (included when groupBy contains 'billingCodeGroup')

billingCodeSubgroup.description: Billing code subgroup as `(<first code>-<last code>) <label>` (included when groupBy contains 'billingCodeSubgroup')

network.description: Individual (un-normalized) network name defining the benchmark group (included when groupBy contains 'network')

schema.description: Array of market benchmark results. Each object contains grouping dimensions (based on groupBy parameter) and a metrics/value pair representing the calculated statistics.

400.description: Invalid request parameters or query limits exceeded.

401.description: User not authenticated or invalid API key

402.description: Not enough API credit for this request.

403.description: User does not have permission to access this endpoint

429.description: Request rate limit exceeded; retry after backing off.

post.description: Search for **published provider-specific negotiated rates** by NPI, TIN, or CCN. Preserve the matched provider identifier, payer, plan or network, billing code and type, billing class, service code, modifier, negotiated type, and source period when comparing rows. Multiple rows for one payer and code may represent different contracts or contexts. A published rate does not by itself establish a claim's allowed or paid amount. For cursor pagination, send `pagination: {}` (default page size 1,000), then repeat the same request with `pagination.cursor` set to the returned `nextCursor` until it is null. Each page is billed separately. The organization's configured maximum can be lower or higher than 1,000, up to 10,000. Without `pagination`, the legacy array response is unchanged.

providerRatesByNpi.description: Get negotiated rates for provider with NPI 1073502985 for specific billing codes

providerRatesByTin.description: Get negotiated rates for provider group with TIN 123456789

providerRatesByCcn.description: Get negotiated institutional rates for hospital with CCN 050001

field.description: Order rows by rate instead of by provider and group fields; rows with the same rate keep the provider and group order, and rows without a rate come last. Applied before pagination; a cursor is valid only for the same sort. Not available to trial accounts (403) or unauthenticated requests (401).

sort.description: Sort order as a list holding one `{field, direction}` entry. Only one sort entry is supported; a request with more than one returns 400.

npis.description: NPIs to query negotiated rates for (optional, specify at least one of npis, tins, or ccns)

tins.description: TINs to query negotiated rates for (optional, specify at least one of npis, tins, or ccns)

ccns.description: CCNs to query negotiated rates for (optional, specify at least one of npis, tins, or ccns)

providers.description: Provider identifiers to query rates for. At least one provider identifier (NPI, TIN, or CCN) must be specified.

billingCodeAndTypes.description: Specific billing codes to search for (required)

billingClasses.description: Professional vs institutional (optional). Rates a payer published for `both` classes are returned under either.

serviceCodes.description: Place of service codes to filter by (optional) Rates published with no place of service or `CSTM-00` apply at every place of service and are always returned; group by `serviceCode` to tell them apart.

billingCodeModifiers.description: Billing code modifiers to filter by (optional)

negotiatedTypeGroups.description: Rate type groups to search for (optional), e.g. ["dollar"]. Prefer this to negotiatedTypes. 'dollar' covers negotiated, fee schedule, and every other dollar type; 'per diem' and 'percentage' values are not dollars per service.

negotiatedTypes.description: Raw rate negotiation types to search for (optional); prefer negotiatedTypeGroups unless negotiated and fee schedule rates must be separated. When both are set, a rate must match both.

yearMonths.description: Year/month periods to filter by (optional). Leave empty to query the latest available data; supply specific periods only when comparing rates across time.

planNames.description: Normalized plan names to narrow results to specific insurance plans (optional).

networks.description: Individual (un-normalized) network names to narrow results to specific networks, exactly as reported in the payer transparency file (optional).

groupBy.description: Fields to group results by (optional). Including network or planName adds the corresponding deduplicated array without splitting otherwise-identical provider-rate groups. planName arrays are sorted and limited to at most 30 names.

pagination.description: Opt in to cursor pagination. Omit for the legacy array response.

pageSize.description: Rows per page. Limited by the organization's configured maximum; defaults to the smaller of 1,000 and that maximum.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the preceding page. Keep every other request field unchanged.

200.description: Legacy array response, or {data, sourceMonths, nextCursor} when pagination is supplied.

post.description:
Statistics over the charges hospitals in the given states publish in their **hospital price transparency files**. `metrics.field` picks the value; each hospital counts once per group, at its highest value. One row per `groupBy` combination, holding the `groupBy` values and each requested statistic under its own name: `billingCode` returns the code and `billingCodeType` you requested, combining the CPT and HCPCS labels and the 3- and 4-digit DRG and revenue code forms hospitals publish; `methodology` returns its public name (`feeSchedule`, `caseRate`, ...) when known; `ccn` returns one row per hospital, with its `hospitalName`. A request that matches nothing returns no rows (`total` 0).

**Mixed rates:** without `payer` and `methodology` in `groupBy`, one group mixes commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid rates, and fee-schedule, per-diem, and case-rate dollars, so its statistics describe no single contract type. Group by `payer` and `methodology` (or filter `methodologies`), and by `billingCode` and `setting` unless the filters fix them, before comparing values.

Without `yearMonths`, each hospital's (by CCN) newest file among the latest two months is used, whatever the other filters match. States outside the organization's state restrictions, or more states than the account allows, are rejected.

post.description:
Retrieve hospitals and other Medicare-certified facilities by CMS Certification Number (CCN). The response is a list with one entry per facility found, in request order. A CCN with no facility record is left out.

Every result includes `ccn`, `name`, `city`, `state`, and `npi` (the facility's organization NPI, when known). Add `includeFields` values for more details. A five-digit CCN missing its leading zero, such as `50690`, is looked up as `050690`; any other malformed CCN fails the request with 400. An empty `ccns` array or an empty filter array returns `[]`.

To find a CCN by name, location, or facility type, use `POST /api/v1/ccnSearch`.

ccns.description: CMS Certification Numbers: six characters, such as `050454` or `21T101`. Five-digit forms missing the leading zero are accepted. Duplicates are removed.

ccnFacilityTypes.description: Return only facilities with one of these CMS hospital categories. Include `null` to keep facilities without one.

includeFields.description:
Sections to add to each result. `ccn`, `name`, `city`, `state`, and `npi` (the facility's organization NPI) are always returned. An unknown value fails the request with 400.
- `street`, `zipCode`, `phone`: address and phone.
- `providerType`: CMS provider type, such as `Short Term Acute Care Hospital` or `Critical Access Hospital`.
- `ownership`, `bedCount`, `affiliatedHealthSystem`, `clinicalServices`.
- `careQuality`: CMS overall star rating.
- `imageUrls`: up to five photos (`imageUrl1` to `imageUrl5`) with their credits in `imageCredits`.
- `quality`: CMS quality results by care setting: the star rating, the headline measures, and every measure CMS reports with state averages, national ranks, and value-based program history.
- `inNetworkPayers`: payers that list the facility's NPI in network.
- `payerTins`: Tax IDs that payers list for the facility in their price files, with the payers and NPIs under each.
- `financials`: the latest Medicare cost report, as `summary` (CMS Hospital Provider Cost Report headline figures) and `detail` (HCRIS financial statements). Null when CMS has neither.
- `cmsProfile`: CMS Provider of Services data: accreditation, ownership, staffing, and service area. Null when CMS has no record.
- `medicareServices`: every Medicare inpatient DRG and outpatient APC CMS publishes for the facility, with volume and payments, most volume first, plus the hospital's CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) Impact File figures such as case mix index and designations. Null when CMS has no record.
- `clinicians`: the number of clinicians CMS lists as affiliated with the facility, their top specialties, and up to 24 of them by name.
- `contractInfo`: negotiated-rate summaries by payer and service category, with the state average for comparison.
- `relatedHospitals`: up to four nearby hospitals of the same provider type.

Each section is returned only when requested.

post.description:
Search hospitals and other Medicare-certified facilities by name, CCN, state, and facility type. Results are ordered by match quality: the facility's own name first, then its other names, then names it shares with another site, then by name.

Each `searchTerms` entry matches anywhere in the CCN, the facility's names and aliases, its health system, city, or state. Words within one term must appear in that order (`Mayo Rochester` matches `Mayo Clinic Hospital Rochester`), and a facility matching any term is returned. Without `searchTerms` or `ccn`, only facilities with six-digit CCNs are returned. A request with no search term, CCN, state, or type filter returns an empty list.

Several results can share one CCN when a hospital has more than one site; `facilityId` tells them apart. Organizations limited to certain states see facilities in those states only.

Ignored with `suggestionsOnly`. Not available to trial accounts (403) or unauthenticated requests (401).

Retrieve provider information for one or more Taxpayer Identification Numbers (TINs). **Note:** CMS allows insurers to report provider TINs using either an NPI or Employer Identification Number (EIN).

The response is a list with one entry per Tax ID found, in request order; each entry carries its `tin`. A Tax ID absent from the data is left out.

`tinType`, `tinAddress`, `inNetworkPayers`, `sampleIndividualNpis`, and `topCodes` are the values `POST /api/v1/tinSearch` returns, and are absent for a TIN the provider directory has not indexed.
- `tinType`: `ein` or `npi`.
- `sampleIndividualNpis`: sample individual NPIs billing under the TIN, as `{npi, name}` entries.
- `topCodes`: up to 20 codes the TIN bills most, as `{code, type}` entries (for example `{"code": "99213", "type": "CPT"}`). Requires a signed-in user or API key.

cmsCodes.description: CPT or HCPCS codes, for example `["95004", "95024"]`. Keeps providers with Medicare or Medicaid volume in any of them, and adds `cmsVolume` (all codes) and `cmsCodeVolumes` (each requested code's volume) to every result. Volume is Medicare services plus Medicaid claims over every loaded year. A provider's index entry holds its 100 highest-volume codes, so a code it bills rarely may not match, and CMS omits low-volume rows. Requires a signed-in user or API key (401 otherwise). Returns 503 while the search index does not yet hold CMS volume.

field.description: `npiCount` orders by the number of NPIs under the Tax ID (`tinSize`), largest first, instead of by name match; it requires `states` or `taxonomyCodes`, returns at most 100 Tax IDs (a `limit` above 100 returns 400), adds `tinSize` to each result, and returns 400 when too many very large Tax IDs match to rank. `cmsVolume` orders by CMS volume (Medicare services plus Medicaid claims, all loaded years): volume in `cmsCodes` when given, otherwise total volume. Medicare counts services, so each billing unit of a drug (a J code) or lab test counts as one and drug- or lab-heavy groups rank high on total volume. A Tax ID's volume credits the full volume of every NPI linked to it (connection score 70 or higher), and an NPI linked to several Tax IDs counts in each, so Tax ID volumes overlap and must not be summed; it is not limited to the searched state. Returns 503 while the search index does not yet hold CMS volume. Not available to trial accounts (403) or unauthenticated requests (401).

direction.description: Applies to `cmsVolume` only; returns 400 with `npiCount`. Defaults to `desc`, highest first.

post.summary: Search billing codes by code or description
post.description:
Find billing codes by code or by words in their description, ranked for autocomplete.

Each entry in `searchTerms` is matched separately, and a code is returned when it matches any of them:
- A code, or the start of one (`9921`), matches codes that begin with it.
- Words match codes whose description or category contains every word (`office visit`). A term with fewer than three letters is matched as a code only.
- A code type in a term (`99213 CPT`) limits the results to that type.

If your organization's plan is limited to certain billing codes, only those codes are returned.

searchTerms.description: Codes, partial codes, or description words. Each term is matched separately and a code is returned when it matches any term. Only the first 40 characters of each term are used.

codeTypes.description: Only return codes of these types. Defaults to every type. Each returned `{code, type}` can be sent as-is in `billingCodeAndTypes` on the rate endpoints.

limit.description: Maximum number of codes to return.

includeFields.description:
Optional fields to add to each result.
- `topTaxonomies`: taxonomy codes of the providers that bill the code most, highest first. Absent when no ranking is available for the code.

200.description: Matching billing codes, best match first

grouping.description: The code type followed by its category and subcategory, for display

topTaxonomies.description: Returned with `includeFields: ["topTaxonomies"]`. Taxonomy codes, highest billing volume first.

post.description: Retrieve CMS Medicare reference amounts for physician fee schedules, drug average sales prices, MS-DRG weights, anesthesia conversion factors, or clinical laboratory fee schedules. Available to every API key.

medicareType.description: CMS fee schedule or reference dataset to query.

codes.description: Optional HCPCS/CPT or MS-DRG codes to retrieve. For `anesthesia_conversion_factor`, codes are anesthesia CPT codes (00100-01999): each row then carries one code with its base units, and a code outside the anesthesia schedule returns no rows.

years.description: Optional release year filters. History reaches back to 2002 for `physician_ffs`, 2005 for `drug_asp`, 2006 for `anesthesia_conversion_factor`, FY2008 for `msdrg_weight` and 2001 for `clinical_lab`.

states.description: Optional state filters for physician fee schedule, DMEPOS and anesthesia results. Use `national` for the physician national locality; for anesthesia, `national` returns the national factor alongside every locality.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Rows to skip before the page starts. Defaults to 0.

field.description: `code` requires `codes` when `medicareType` is `anesthesia_conversion_factor`, whose rows otherwise carry no code.

sort.description: Sort order as a list holding one `{field, direction}` entry, placed ahead of the schedule's default order (newest first). Only one sort entry is supported; a request with more than one returns 400.

physicianFeeSchedule.summary: Physician fees for two CPT codes in Massachusetts

200.description: Medicare reference results with the total row count.

data.description: Reference rows. Fields vary by `medicareType` and include the applicable code, rate or weight, year/month, location, and description fields. `anesthesia_conversion_factor` returns one row per release and carrier/locality with `year`, `month`, `state`, `carrier`, `locality`, and `conversion_factor`; with `codes`, one row per code and carrier/locality that also has `code` and `base_unit` (the code's Medicare base units, or null).

total.description: Rows matching the filters, before pagination.

filters.description: Normalized filters, `limit`, and `offset` applied to the query.

hasMore.description: Whether rows remain after this page.

400.description: Invalid request body or an empty codes array.

401.description: The API key is missing or invalid.

402.description: The account does not have enough API credits.

403.description: The caller lacks permission for this operation.

429.description: The request exceeded the applicable rate limit.

tags.name: Payer APIs
tags.description: Retrieve payer-level metadata — supported payers, available data periods, and plan names for a given insurance payer.

tags.name: Provider APIs
tags.description: Look up and search for healthcare providers by NPI, TIN, name, location, taxonomy, entity type, in-network payers, or affiliations. Supports both direct lookups and fuzzy search — suited for building provider directories and network analysis.

tags.name: Billing Code APIs
tags.description: Search billing codes by code or description, with the taxonomies that bill each code most. Suited for code pickers and for finding the codes to pass to the pricing APIs.

tags.name: Pricing APIs
tags.description: Retrieve negotiated rates and market statistics. Includes market-wide benchmarks (percentiles, averages, min/max), provider-specific rates (by NPI, TIN, or CCN), individual rate records across a market segment, and hospital-published rates from price transparency files.

tags.name: Reference API
tags.description: Retrieve CMS Medicare reference amounts across physician, drug, inpatient, anesthesia, and clinical laboratory schedules, and state Medicaid fee-for-service schedules. Medicare is available to every API key; Medicaid follows the organization's endpoint policy.
